audit.whatIsWrong: Row 6 said Skill, but whys[6] on the same page says '2+ items favours Nautilus', the late prose says 'Nautilus wins the long game', and the packet chart says Nautilus.
audit.why: Full-tank Nautilus with Dredge Line (Q) into Depth Charge (R) is a chain-CC engage the Urgot execute stops reaching. Three sources on this page already say so; only the row token disagreed.
audit.corrected: Row 6 = Nautilus, rating 3/10, proposed as a matched pair across both layers. Rows 0-5 already match the packet and are untouched.

audit.why: Lvl 3-5 / Lvl 6 / 1st item / Late are the right four windows; the Lvl 3-5 text needed its mechanism corrected, not its timing.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text rewritten around the real Purge targeting rule and Dredge Line's 14s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly credits Urgot's Q with an auto-attack amp: 'Q Corrosive Charge amps your autos', 'your Q amp lets you win every short trade', 'while your Q amp is up'. It also says Echoing Flames 'chunks him whenever you land Q'.
audit.why: Riot's text is explicit on both. Corrosive Charge only 'deals physical damage and slows'. Echoing Flames triggers off 'Urgot's basic attacks and Purge' — not off Q. The real interaction the page was groping for is Purge's targeting: it 'prioritizes enemy champions Urgot has recently struck with other abilities', so a Q that tags Nautilus makes Purge lock onto him through the minion wave.
audit.corrected: Tag him with Corrosive Charge so Purge locks on, then let the legs fire off your autos and Purge. Dredge Line is 14s at rank 1 falling to 10s, collides with the first enemy so a minion body-blocks it; Riptide is 7s to 5s and Titan's Wrath a flat 12s shield — commit after the shield expires.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags zero sequencing cues, and breakdown.cooldowns listed Dredge Line twice with no numbers.
audit.why: Every commit in this lane is timed off the hook and the shield.
audit.corrected: Dredge Line 14s, Riptide 7s, Titan's Wrath 12s all written in with the order to fight in.

edits.after: You out-damage Nautilus in this window: tag him with Corrosive Charge (Q) so Purge (W) locks onto him, and Echoing Flames fires off every auto. Dredge Line (Q) is 14s at rank 1 — trade inside it.

edits.after: Level 2 favours you: Purge hunts whoever your Q tagged, so short trades are yours.
